summary: the factor between two registered units of one dimension, and a value converted by it, into an engine's own unit only through the unit a scale says it stands for

inputs.name: value
inputs.meaning: the value to convert, in from_unit

inputs.name: from_unit
inputs.meaning: the registry's entry of the value's unit: name, si_factor and dim, as the registry holds them

inputs.name: to_unit
inputs.meaning: the registry's entry of the unit the value is wanted in

inputs.name: stands_for
inputs.meaning: where to_unit has no si_factor, the registry's entry of the registered unit a confirmed scale says it stands for; null otherwise

outputs.name: factor
outputs.meaning: si_factor(from) over si_factor(to, or the unit its scale stands for); null when not convertible

outputs.name: converted
outputs.meaning: the value times the factor, in to_unit; null when not convertible

outputs.name: value
outputs.meaning: the value handed, unchanged, in from_unit

outputs.name: why
outputs.meaning: why no factor exists; absent when converted

validity: multiplicative units only, as the registry holds them; offset units (Celsius) are not registered and a temperature is carried in kelvin

source.citation: contracts/units.json, the registry's note (a definition: multiplicative units, si_factor converts to SI base units, dim is the dimension vector); the Bohr radius in metres, CODATA 2022, as the registry's entry of bohr cites it (https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/cuu/Value?bohrrada0, read by the design role 2026-11-20)
source.locus: the note at the head of contracts/units.json; the entries bohr, Angstrom, Ry/bohr^2, eV/Angstrom^2, Pa.s and mPa.s

note: Written for meta_agent/tasks/031: a bundle that receives a hand-over converts each value only through this skill, its caller (the bundle's src/handover.py) reading the registry the bundle carries and handing the entries, since a skill opens nothing. The factor is a definition, so no value of a source stands behind the cases but the si_factors themselves, which are the registry's as it stood on 2026-11-20; each case's arithmetic is in its worked field. Its cases are worked on two unrelated kinds of system.
